text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh♪ Well, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Don't I feel a bit different? Like I've shed my old self and become totally grown-up, right!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Running my debut race made it feel so real!
I'm finally in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I feel like jumping into the next race right now!
That way I can catch up to the Prez that much sooner!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll do my best
in training again starting tomorrow!

And so, with her debut race successfully behind her,
the very next day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... phew~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm done running, Trainer.
What training are we doing next?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ask anything of the Twinkle Series' rising star,
the great Teio-sama!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Looks like it was a very fulfilling debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Air Groove! I'm finally making
my Twinkle Series debut!
Air Groove, who was already making a name for herself in the Twinkle Series, approached to speak.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I saw it.
That was a fine run.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, you've merely reached the starting line.
The real challenge begins now, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aww, I know that much! I'm gonna go out there and win race after race from now on!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Since we're both here,
wanna do some tandem training with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You and me...? Just so you know,
I won't pull any punches, even if you just debuted."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No need to hold back!
I'll show you what the new and improved Teio can do!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Trainer, can I do a tandem run with Air Groove?"
I thought running alongside an experienced partner would offer a lot of great learning opportunities—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Let's have a match then!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now that you've made your debut, let me take a good, hard look at your true abilities.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Phew... phew...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *pant*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh, I lost~!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Your pacing and timing to make a move still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that was just a difference in experience.
Your ability is beyond reproach."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"And above all, she possesses a determined,
positive mindset that clings on desperately until the very end."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It makes total sense why the President holds you in high regard.
You're going to get even faster and stronger from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course!
I'm the one who's gonna overtake the Prez!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, if you intend to challenge the President,
you will need to demonstrate ability worthy of the task.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You're aiming for it, aren't you?
The 'Classic Races.'"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course! First, I've gotta
become number one among my peers!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And overwhelmingly number one, at that!
Winning every single Classic Triple Crown race—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become a Triple Crown Umamusume
just like Prez, you'll see!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So with that, Trainer!
Let's enter the first leg of the Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho! The Satsuki Sho!
"To be honest, winning even a single Classic race is a massive feat, so taking it one step at a time—"
choice_data_list: First, a prep race at the Wakagoma Stakes!
First, a prep race in the Wakagoma Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
A prep race...? Hmm, well, it's true
that I'd kinda like to see what everyone's capable of...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Got it! First up is the Wakagoma Stakes, right?!
From there, we'll breeze right through to the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm looking forward to seeing
how much she'll grow throughout the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Saying you're looking forward to my growth
makes you sound like a mom.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? Don't talk nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll run in a lot more races and get stronger,
Mom!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh...! I am not your mother!
And so, with our eyes on the Classic races, we set our sights on the Wakagoma Stakes.
